documents.name: 01-Platform-Overview.md
documents.content:
# Digital Banking Platform

## Overview
A next-generation digital banking platform supporting retail and corporate accounts, real-time transactions, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance (PSD2, GDPR).

## Stakeholders
- Retail Customers
- Corporate Clients
- Bank Admins
- Compliance Officers
- Regulators
- Third-party Integrators (PISP, AISP)

## Key Features
- Multi-currency account management
- Real-time payment processing (SEPA, SWIFT)
- Fraud detection with ML
- KYC/AML compliance
- Open Banking APIs (PSD2)
- Mobile and web banking
- Push notifications and alerts
- Transaction reporting

documents.name: 02-Tech-Stack.md
documents.content:
# Tech Stack

- Frontend: React Native (Mobile), React (Web)
- Backend: Spring Boot (Microservices)
- Database: PostgreSQL (transactions), MongoDB (customer profiles)
- Cache: Redis
- Event Bus: Apache Kafka
- Security: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, mTLS
- Fraud Detection: Python ML service (TensorFlow)
- Monitoring: ELK Stack, Grafana
